approved_payload.content: Police say two men, aged 23 and 37, were fatally wounded in a shooting in Military Road, Steenberg, at about 12:30 on Tuesday 20 October. The suspects fled in a red VW Polo, abandoned it in Kirstenhof after a high-speed chase and hijacked a white Toyota RunX; police arrested five men aged 27 to 40, whom they describe as "gang-affiliated", and recovered two assault rifles from the hijacked car (SAPS Western Cape statement on X, 20 October; Cape Times names the police spokesperson as Constable Ndakhe Gwala). Police did not say where the arrests were made; Smile 90.4FM, in an updated story, says Lakeside, as does Briefly News' account of the mayor's post on X. By that account the mayor gives the weapons as two AK-47 rifles and a 9mm pistol; police name two assault rifles. The suspects were due in the Wynberg Magistrate's Court once charged. No motive was stated. The victims and suspects were not named. Three reports, all resting on the one police statement: Cape Times (IOL), Smile 90.4FM and Briefly News.
